about.html:
Hi, I'm Aminul Islam Saqib, a backend developer passionate about building reliable, scalable, and AI-ready systems. I've worked on projects ranging from CRM platforms and customer support SaaS to EdTech systems and microservice-based applications.

With experience in Node.js, NestJS, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, and AWS, I specialize in designing APIs and infrastructures that can support AI/ML workflows — whether it's data aggregation, real-time event processing, or integrating intelligent services.

I'm especially excited about the future of AI-driven automation and how backend systems can power smarter, more adaptive applications.

projects.title: Somoyer School
projects.description: An e-learning platform offering various digital educational solutions, including online courses, workshops, and career development services. The platform provides free and premium courses with video lessons, notes, quizzes, and assignments.
responsibilities: Architected scalable backend infrastructure with comprehensive RESTful APIs for lesson management, authentication, payment processing, and certificate generation serving 10,000+ active users.
Implemented secure MongoDB data layer with role-based access control, middleware guards, and optimized queries achieving 99.5% system reliability.
Led cross-functional collaboration with frontend teams and conducted code reviews in Agile environment, ensuring seamless API integration and maintainable codebase.

projects.title: B2C Online Food Delivery System
projects.description: A comprehensive Business-to-Customer food delivery platform where customers can order from various restaurants, customize orders with add-ons and flavors, apply vouchers for discounts, and track order status in real-time.
responsibilities: Designed microservices architecture from scratch with RabbitMQ messaging system, enabling scalable inter-service communication and 50% faster order processing.
Built comprehensive authentication system with JWT tokens, OTP verification, and refresh token rotation ensuring enterprise-level security standards.
Integrated Aamarpay payment gateway with CORS-enabled APIs, supporting multiple payment methods and real-time transaction tracking.

projects.title: Livestock Payment System
projects.description: A secure payment execution platform for livestock transactions developed for a government entity. Focuses on real-time data tracking and safe payment gateway integration with emphasis on security and compliance.
responsibilities: Developed secure government-compliant payment platform using NestJS and MongoDB, handling livestock transactions worth $2M+ with zero security incidents.
Implemented enterprise-grade authentication with role-based access control and audit trails, meeting strict government security requirements.
Integrated bKash payment gateway with custom APIs and real-time transaction monitoring, achieving 99.8% payment success rate.

projects.title: Meda-X Research Platform
projects.description: A comprehensive data collection and analysis software designed for medical researchers as a resource aggregation application. Enables automated data collection from multiple sources with advanced analytics capabilities.
responsibilities: Built automated data collection system using Node.js web crawlers and Redis caching, processing 1M+ medical research records daily with 95% accuracy rate.
Developed full-stack solution with Spring Boot APIs and PostgreSQL database, optimizing queries to reduce data processing time by 60%.
Created cross-platform Flutter frontend with advanced analytics dashboard, enabling researchers to visualize complex medical data insights in real-time.
